wrong_claims: Section 6: 'The System Administrator profile sees the field through its profile grant on deploy and View All Data.' View All Data does not override field-level security, and deploying a CustomField through the Metadata API grants no profile FLS unless the profile is in the deploy. The admin user only sees the field because the Agentforce_Reference_App and Pronto_Deep_Dive_Workshop permission sets are assigned to it.

defects.defect: States that View All Data plus a 'profile grant on deploy' gives System Administrators access to the new field. VAD does not bypass FLS, and a field deploy grants no FLS. The inventory has no Admin profile row, and the reasoning for leaving it out is wrong (admins do see it, but only through the two permission sets).
defects.skill_gap: The org-verification reference in SKILL.md says users with View All Data see fields without FLS grants (the r075 and r077 runs flag this too). That note is wrong and should be replaced with: FLS applies to every user, including admins; name the grant that gives each persona access.

defects.defect: Labels the claim 'sees the field through ... View All Data' as documented platform behavior, so an unverified and wrong claim is presented as fact.
defects.skill_gap: Same incorrect View All Data note in the SKILL.md org-verification reference.
